method_notes: 7-day historical window ends 2026-09-20T17:40:00Z before this session NAS/Kubernetes/Proxmox load tests. Rates use 5min windows sampled every10min; maxima can miss brief spikes; p95 describes sampled windows not individual IOs.

CPU nonidle excluding iowait includes steal time, which is separately measured. It is an upper bound on active execution, not application CPU alone. Query excluding steal timed out, so not silently substituted.
MemTotal minus MemAvailable is not equivalent to kubectl top working set. Host VM RAM occupancy and NAS ARC must not be mistaken for application demand.
Shed host/node series have only approximately half of expected samples; missing samples are not idle time.

Disk mean latency is per5min read/write completion mean; p95 is over those means, not IO p95. Virtual node sd devices include Longhorn volume devices: use physical-node disks to assess underlying media.
Historical OOM counter increments cannot distinguish container cgroup limit exhaustion from host memory exhaustion. No attribution to specific workload established.

Raw temperature maximum across arbitrary sensors is unsuitable as CPU temperature. Threadripper Tctl103.625C is fan-control, corresponding Tdie max76.625C; Tccd1 max98.5C requires sensor support validation. No AMD CPU throttle counter was present. Intel physical throttle counters were present and zero.
